operating_notes.text: Target Zuri Hotels and Resorts Private Limited owns 'The Zuri Kumarakom, Kerala Resort & Spa' (72 keys, 18 acres).
Company plans to incorporate a wholly owned subsidiary in Dubai, UAE, for operating hotels and restaurants.

holders.name: Administrator of the Specified Undertaking of the Unit Trust of India

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,253.7 Cr (+18.2% YoY), net profit ₹317.43 Cr (+23.1% YoY).
ITC Hotels executed SPA to acquire 100% of Zuri Hotels and Resorts for up to ₹175 Cr (EV ₹205 Cr).
ITC Hotels completed the 100% acquisition of Zuri Hotels and Resorts Private Limited on 19 May 2026 for up to ₹175 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,054.14 Cr (+25.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹201.02 Cr (+51.4% YoY).
The board approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in Dubai, UAE, with an investment of up to ₹20 Cr.
